candidates.name: Reverse Expansion Bicep Curls Kneeling
candidates.cardText:
Reverse Expansion Bicep Curls Kneeling
Novice
1
Kneel tall, arms long, palms forward.
2
Set shoulders down, engage core and glutes.
3
Bend elbows, curling hands toward shoulders without leaning back.
4
Extend arms slowly, maintaining upright posture and strap tension.

candidates.name: Back Rowing Preps Roll Down With Bicep Curl Seated
candidates.cardText:
Back Rowing Preps Roll Down With Bicep Curl Seated
Novice
1
Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps, elbows straight.
2
Roll spine down sequentially while bending elbows into a bicep curl.
3
Pause briefly, keeping shoulders relaxed and core engaged.
4
Reverse the roll up, extending arms forward with controlled tension.

candidates.name: Back Rowing Preps Bicep Curls Seated
candidates.cardText:
Back Rowing Preps Bicep Curls Seated
Novice
1
Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at shoulder height.
2
Start with arms straight, palms facing up, shoulders relaxed.
3
Bend elbows, curling hands toward shoulders without moving torso.
4
Extend arms slowly, maintaining control and constant tension on straps.

candidates.name: Pilates Single Arm Rotations Back Rowing Seated Row
candidates.cardText:
Pilates Single Arm Rotations Back Rowing Seated Row
Beginner
1
Sit tall, hold one strap, arm extended forward.
2
Pull handle while rotating torso slightly.
3
Keep hips stable and movement controlled.
4
Return arm and torso to start.

candidates.name: Pilates Single Arm Back Rowing Seated Row
candidates.cardText:
Pilates Single Arm Back Rowing Seated Row
Beginner
1
Sit tall, hold one strap, arm extended forward.
2
Pull handle toward torso, squeezing shoulder blade.
3
Keep torso stable without rotation.
4
Extend arm forward under control.

candidates.name: Pilates Back Rowing Seated Row
candidates.cardText:
Pilates Back Rowing Seated Row
Beginner
1
Sit tall, legs extended, hold straps with arms forward.
2
Pull handles toward torso, squeezing shoulder blades together.
3
Keep chest lifted and spine neutral throughout.
4
Extend arms forward under control.
